entities.name: Hydra
entities.description: A serpent with many heads, each of which grows back if cut off; the iconic creature type of green found on many planes.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: The behemoth regarded as the soul of the world of Alara, of which hydras are manifestations.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane whose hydras are manifestations of its world soul Progenitus.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane whose hydras have cobra-like heads.

entities.name: Kaladesha
entities.description: A plane whose hydras emit the glow of aether and devour aether-powered machines.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: A plane with snapping hydras that resemble multi-headed snapping turtles.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that creates hydra mutants such as the Hydroid Krasis.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that grows carnivorous phytohydras.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that uses Savageborn Hydras to unleash devastation and reveres them.

events.summary: Following the Sundering of Alara, hydras are limited to the Shards of Naya and Jund; during the Conflux new hydras such as the Apocalypse Hydra come into conflict with other Shards.
events.quote: During the Conflux , new types of Hydras, like the Apocalypse Hydra , appeared that came into conflict with the other Shards, like Bant .

relations.note: Hydras are regarded as manifestations of Progenitus, Alara's world soul.
relations.quote: Hydras are regarded as the manifestations of the "soul of the world" of Alara , the behemoth Progenitus .
Phytohydras are carnivorous plants with hydra-like regeneration and growth abilities grown by the Selesnya Conclave .

relations.note: Savageborn Hydras are part of the clans, which revere them.
relations.quote: The Gruul revere these multiheaded predators as vestiges of the ancient times before the guilds took over the world.
